reason: San Cristóbal de las Casas airport (Mexico) closed in 2010; OpenTravelData still carries a current record for it, so a retired entry would come back if ever re-seeded.
Dunnville Airport (Ontario) closed 2013-05-30 for a wind farm; DU9 was a Transport Canada identifier, never an IATA code.
Oslo Fornebu closed 1998-10-07, replaced by Gardermoen (OSL).
Hardwick Field (Cleveland, Tennessee) closed 2013-12-31, replaced by Cleveland Regional Jetport; HDI was an FAA identifier, never an IATA code.
Marine Corps Air Station El Toro closed 1999-07-02; NZJ was an FAA identifier, never an IATA code.
Słupsk-Redzikowo: no traffic since at least 2007, airfield demolished from 2016 for the Aegis Ashore site.
Downsview Airport (Toronto) closed April 2024; it was a Bombardier test field with no scheduled service.
